notes.title: EDITING CONTRACT
notes.text: 1080×1920 · 30fps · one continuous presenter. No product substitutions. Keep both handles, inward-falling strap tails and oval closure intact. No simulated interior or capacity demonstrations. Caption groups follow actual VO; final timing must be aligned before export.

notes.title: FULFILLMENT
notes.text: Pre-order; shipping expected October. Confirm before publishing. Do not display prices.

notes.title: PRODUCTION STATUS
notes.text: Product master and presenter portrait are references. Fresh generated visuals, narration, lip-sync, aligned captions and final render are pending in the all-in-one app.

moodboard.caption: Existing synthetic brand presenter Helen; proposed picture-in-picture performer. New narration and lip-sync pending.

source_assets.use: Same master all beats; contain within x72,y240,w864,h864. Preserve whole silhouette; no upscaled detail crop.
New HeyGen take; key green; x660,y1260,w260,h390. Preserve hair and hands; presenter must not cover bag, captions or disclosure.

pending_assets: new master-verified product visuals for the app
production.caption_plan: Single line only, 54px white text/dark stroke at 1080 width. Exact rectangle x72,y1120,w858,h90, ending at y1210; presenter begins at y1260. Actual spoken words only, 2–5 words per cue. Word-aligned cue timings remain pending VO.
production.audio_plan: One continuous neutral conversational VO, no background music for first calibration. Validate Vivienne and Velantra pronunciation before lip-sync. No speech speed-up to hit target; revise timing to actual recording.
production.disclosure_plan: Panel x72,y1320,w528,h190 from 18–24s: PRE-ORDER / SHIPPING EXPECTED OCTOBER. Minimum40px, high contrast. No prices.
production.final_verification: Inspect full export with audio, every transition ±6 frames, all caption boundaries, first/last frames, chroma edges/hands/hair, sync, logo/closure/strap identity and disclosure readability. Target cuts ±2 frames of intended boundary once VO aligned. Do not declare final QC passed from this board.
production.revision_record: Brooks requested no prices in all ads and a quality focus. Updated narration, graphic cues and brief. Prior QC scores are historical; this revision needs fresh QC. Single-line captions resolve the previous height concern.
production.generation_plan_status: Fresh visual generation required; scene count will be set in the app workflow.
